learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with insight into the area of problem-solving by means of Artificial Intelligence.
Extend gained knowledge and skills in related master programmes.

syllabus_topics: Uninformed search in the solution space
Informed search in the solution space
More complex agents capable of inference including propositional logic
Multilayer feedforward neural network and its applications
assessment_rules: The student must obtain at least half of the points from the written tests to take the final exam. At least half of the points must also be obtained on the final exam. Grading: A (100-91), B (90-81), C (80-71), D (70-61), E (60-51), Fx (50-0).
bibliography: Russell, Stuart and Norvig, Peter: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach (3rd Edition), Prentice Hall, USA, 2010.
Návrat, Pavol a kol.: Umelá inteligencia (3. vydanie), Vydavateľstvo STU, Bratislava, 2015.
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
